description: #1623 — optional per-set effort. Wire: workout_logs.sets[].rpe (number, RPE 6–10 in 0.5 steps; absent = not logged, never null). RIR is a DISPLAY mode only: RIR = 10 − RPE. users.preferences.setEffort = 'rpe' | 'rir' (absent / unknown / 'off' ⇒ off). FORGIVING READ: non-number / non-finite ⇒ absent; rounded to the nearest 0.5; outside 6…10 after rounding ⇒ absent. Runners: GCFitnessCoreTests/SetEffortTests.swift (SetEffort + SetLog decode), android/core SetEffortTest.kt (SetEffort + SetLog.fromMap), backoffice __tests__/set-effort.test.ts (normalizedRpe / rpeField / formatRpe — RPE cases only, the coach always reads RPE).
